compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Correct the Swiss-only target to the existing complete ENTSO-E medium-voltage grid supply. Preserve signed delivered kWh at factor +1. The source market group aggregates country medium-voltage markets with their upstream losses and infrastructure; the native grid supplies medium-voltage electricity through its existing high-voltage input, losses, network and SF6 supply/emission exchanges. Retain these once, with no added loss factor, grid or direct-busbar substitution. ENTSO-E is a geographic screening proxy for Europe without Switzerland, with different country coverage, Swiss inclusion, historical production/import/trade representation, voltage-loss/network assumptions, background and vintage. This mapping does not replace IAM technology shares or alter the native topology. Native 2026 documentation contains a copied production-busbar statement; the actual grid exchanges and 2025 transmission definition establish the selected delivered-grid boundary. Score differences are unquantified.
